# About

Umar Pathan is a Security Researcher and Kernel Developer focused on building fast, privacy-first tools. This portfolio showcases expertise in Linux kernel security, reverse engineering, systems programming, and performance optimization.

## Core Expertise

- Linux Kernel Security
- Security Research & Vulnerability Analysis
- Reverse Engineering
- Systems Programming (Rust/C++)
- Performance Tuning
- Privacy-First Development

## Projects

### HEIC To JPG Converter
Web-based, privacy-first and ultra-fast HEIC to JPG converter. All processing happens locally in the browser - images never leave your device.
- URL: https://heictojpg.pics

## Blog Topics

The blog covers technical topics including:
- Linux kernel security mechanisms (KASLR, SMEP, SMAP, CFI)
- High-performance systems programming in Rust
- Reverse engineering fundamentals
- Privacy-first development practices
